title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of thirty-Six thousand Pesos for the Operating Expenses of the Branch College Ot Liberal Arts Created By Act Numbered Twenty-Nine Hundred and Fifty-Six, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The sum of thirty-six thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular
Treasury, not otherwise appropriated, for the initial operating expenses of the branch college of Liberal Arts
created by Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and fifty-six. The operating expenses of this branch college in
the succeeding years shall be included in the annual appropriation for the university of the Philippines in the
General Appropriation Law.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 8, 1929.
